svg.title: Block hash prefix caching versus a radix tree
svg.desc: Two requests share their first 40 tokens. With 16-token block hashes, vLLM reuses only the first two full blocks, 32 tokens, because the third block differs in its last 8 tokens. The SGLang radix tree with page size 1 splits the node exactly at token 40, so 40 tokens are reused.
svg.text: SHARED: 32 TOKENS · 32–39 RECOMPUTED (HASH OF WHOLE BLOCK DIFFERS)
hash(h_prev, 16 tokens) → block ID · a partial block has no hash
SHARED: 40 TOKENS · SPLIT EXACTLY WHERE THE TOKENS DIFFER
children keyed by first token · page_size > 1 truncates keys to page multiples
